entries.name: AM broadcast band
entries.quote: AM broadcast band. The band of frequencies extending from 535 to 1705 kHz. … The 117 carrier frequencies assigned to AM broadcast stations begin at 540 kHz and progress in 10 kHz steps to 1700 kHz.

entries.name: FM broadcast band
entries.quote: The FM broadcast band consists of that portion of the radio frequency spectrum between 88 MHz and 108 MHz. It is divided into 100 channels of 200 kHz each.
entries.note: Channel 201 is 88.1 MHz and channel 300 is 107.9 MHz (table in §73.201).

entries.name: Unlicensed (U-NII) 5.15–5.25 GHz
entries.quote: For an indoor access point operating in the band 5.15-5.25 GHz, the maximum conducted output power over the frequency band of operation shall not exceed 1 W provided the maximum antenna gain does not exceed 6 dBi.
entries.note: Band named in the §15.407 power limits; the limits differ by band and device class.

entries.name: Unlicensed (U-NII) 5.25–5.35 GHz
entries.quote: For the 5.25-5.35 GHz and 5.47-5.725 GHz bands, the maximum conducted output power over the frequency bands of operation shall not exceed the lesser of 250 mW or 11 dBm + 10 log B, where B is the 26 dB emission bandwidth in megahertz.
entries.note: Band named in the §15.407 power limits; the limits differ by band and device class.

entries.name: Unlicensed (U-NII) 5.47–5.725 GHz
entries.quote: For the 5.25-5.35 GHz and 5.47-5.725 GHz bands, the maximum conducted output power over the frequency bands of operation shall not exceed the lesser of 250 mW or 11 dBm + 10 log B, where B is the 26 dB emission bandwidth in megahertz.
entries.note: Band named in the §15.407 power limits; the limits differ by band and device class.

entries.name: Unlicensed (U-NII) 5.725–5.85 GHz
entries.quote: For the band 5.725-5.850 GHz, the maximum conducted output power over the frequency band of operation shall not exceed 1 W.
entries.note: Band named in the §15.407 power limits; the limits differ by band and device class.

entries.name: Unlicensed (U-NII) 5.925–7.125 GHz
entries.quote: For an indoor access point operating in the 5.925-7.125 GHz band, the maximum power spectral density must not exceed 5 dBm e.i.r.p. in any 1-megahertz band. In addition, the maximum e.i.r.p. over the frequency band of operation must not exceed 30 dBm.
entries.note: Band named in the §15.407 power limits; the limits differ by band and device class.

entries.name: GPS L1
entries.quote: The nominal carrier frequencies (f0) shall be 1575.42 MHz, and 1227.6 MHz for L1 and L2, respectively.
entries.note: Minimum received power of the L1 C/A signal −158.5 dBW at a 3 dBi linearly polarised antenna near the ground, satellite above 5° elevation (Table 3-Va).

entries.name: GPS L2
entries.quote: The nominal carrier frequencies (f0) shall be 1575.42 MHz, and 1227.6 MHz for L1 and L2, respectively.

entries.name: GPS L5
entries.quote: The nominal carrier frequency (f0) -- as it appears to an observer on the ground - shall be 1176.45 MHz, or 115 times
entries.note: Minimum received power −157.9 dBW (Block IIF, Table 3-III).

entries.name: Voyager S-band uplink
entries.quote: The Deep Space Station (DSS) transmits an uplink carrier frequency of 2114.676697 MHz to Voyager 1 and 2113.312500 MHz to Voyager 2.
entries.note: Voyager 2 (DSN channel 14); Voyager 1 uses 2114.676697 MHz (channel 18).

entries.name: Voyager X-band downlink
entries.quote: X-band refers to a downlink frequency of about 8415 MHz.
entries.note: Voyager 2 coherent downlink 8415.000000 MHz (channel 14); Voyager 1 8420.432097 MHz (channel 18). Coherent ratio X-band/uplink = 880/221 (§2.2.1).

entries.name: Voyager S-band downlink
entries.quote: S-band refers to an uplink frequency of about 2115 MHz and a downlink frequency of about 2295 MHz.
entries.note: Voyager 2 coherent S-band downlink 2295.000000 MHz; no longer used (§2).
